name: a11y-audit
description: WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility audits for Shopify stores: dual-engine scan, model judgment pass, keyboard/focus probe, and per-finding attribution to the theme or the injecting app

interface.shortDescription: Audit a storefront against WCAG 2.2 AA and blame the right party.
interface.longDescription: Accessibility audit for Shopify stores: pa11y (axe-core + HTML_CodeSniffer) and Lighthouse scans sampled by theme template, a model judgment pass for what scanners cannot decide, an in-page keyboard/focus probe, and attribution of every finding to the theme or the app that injected it. Never claims compliance from a clean scan.
defaultPrompt: Run an accessibility audit on my store.
Which of these a11y failures are the theme's fault and which came from apps?
Check the keyboard tab order and focus traps on my PDP.
